name: @xyb-community/gpp-workbench
description: 泛发性脓疱型银屑病（GPP）患者与照护者的本机病程资料工作台：把散落的发作记录、体温与血象炎症指标、皮损评分、生物制剂与传统系统治疗用药整理成可核对、可回溯的发作时间轴，并整理成就诊能带着走的问题清单。

scripts.check: node --check dsh/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node scripts/check-workbench-package.mjs . && node scripts/check-host-contract.mjs && node scripts/smoke-activate.mjs && node scripts/check-probe-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-version-literal.mjs && node scripts/check-static-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-choice-limit.mjs && node scripts/check-assertion-strength.mjs && node scripts/check-derivative-leftovers.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-snapshot.mjs . --if-present && node scripts/check-primer-links.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-pane-contract.mjs . && node scripts/check-data-dir.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-chain.mjs . && node scripts/check-patient-create.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-matching.mjs . && node scripts/check-schema-words.mjs . && node scripts/check-placeholder-free.mjs . && node scripts/check-wording.mjs . && node scripts/check-ui-parity.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run test && npm run audit
